story.title: The Library of Unwritten Books
story.visual_bible: A quiet, old-world public library at midnight; warm amber desk lamp, deep blue moonlight through tall windows, consistent middle-aged librarian with dark hair in a low bun, round spectacles, forest-green cardigan; recurring cream linen-bound blank book with a small brass clasp; cinematic storybook illustration, vertical 9:16, no text or lettering.

story_beats.speech: Every night, just before midnight, a blank book appeared on the library desk. By morning, it was gone.
story_beats.visual_prompt: A quiet old library after midnight, a single cream linen-bound blank book with a brass clasp appearing on a polished wooden desk beneath a warm amber lamp, tall shadowed bookshelves and blue moonlight, no people, cinematic storybook illustration.

story_beats.speech: One evening, the librarian opened it. The pages described a stranger who would arrive before dawn, carrying a book of his own.
story_beats.visual_prompt: The same middle-aged librarian with dark hair in a low bun, round spectacles and forest-green cardigan reading the open blank-looking cream book at the desk, faint delicate ink-like lines suggested but no readable text, clock nearing midnight, cinematic storybook illustration.

story_beats.speech: At the door, a stranger appeared exactly as the pages had promised. In his hands was a book bearing the librarian's name.
story_beats.visual_prompt: At the library entrance before dawn, a mysterious but non-threatening traveler in a charcoal coat stands holding a closed dark leather book with a small brass nameplate turned away and unreadable, the same librarian watching from behind the desk, rain-speckled glass doors, cinematic storybook illustration.

story_beats.speech: She refused to let the book decide what happened next. She took her pen and wrote the ending herself.
story_beats.visual_prompt: Close view of the same librarian calmly writing in the cream linen-bound book at the desk, the stranger waiting respectfully in the softly lit background, first golden dawn light entering the tall windows, hopeful cinematic storybook illustration, no legible writing.
